items.name: Pal Sphere
items.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. This basic model is only effective on low level Pals.

items.name: Mega Sphere
items.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. Its capabilities have been improved, allowing it to catch a wider range of Pals.

items.name: Giga Sphere
items.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. Able to capture moderately powerful Pals.

items.name: Hyper Sphere
items.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. Enhanced capabilities allow it to capture even more powerful Pals.

items.name: Ultra Sphere
items.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. Not many Pals can escape its highly efficient design.

items.name: Legendary Sphere
items.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. Very few Pals can escape its perfected design.

items.name: Ultimate Sphere
items.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. Almost no Pals can escape its flawless design.

items.name: Exotic Sphere
items.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. Boasting incredible performance, it can capture Pals that fall outside regular standards.

items.name: Sol Sphere
items.description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. A high-grade Sphere from an ancient civilization that secured coexistence with Pals.

items.name: Ancient Sphere
items.description: A tool that captures Pals when thrown. An ultimate Sphere created as the pinnacle of an ancient civilization, imbued with the power of the World Tree.

items.name: Heavy Weight Module
items.description: Equipping it makes the sphere heavier, reducing its range but increasing its capture power.Sphere Weight +1 Capture Strength +1

items.name: Curve Module
items.description: Equipping it causes the sphere to spin with a curved trajectory. It becomes easier to catch Pals off guard, and increases capture power.Sphere Curve +1 Capture Strength +2

items.name: Sniper Module
items.description: Equipping it increases the sphere's range, allowing it to sharply capture Pals and enhancing capture power.Sphere Range +1 Capture Strength +2

items.name: Slider Module
items.description: Equipping it adds a slider spin to the sphere. The sphere curves at a sharp angle, making it easier to catch Pals off guard and increasing capture power.Sphere Slider Capture Strength +3

items.name: Sniper Module II
items.description: Equipping it significantly increases the sphere's range, allowing it to sharply capture Pals and enhancing capture power.Sphere Range +2 Capture Strength +3

items.name: Homing Module
items.description: Equipping it makes the sphere home in on Pals, further increasing capture power.Sphere Homing Capture Strength +3

items.name: Assault Rifle
items.description: An Assault Rifle that mows down enemies with overwhelming force. It excels at rapid-fire and is well suited to taking down powerful foes.

items.name: Stone Axe
items.description: An axe for cutting wood. Made from stone, it's not very sharp.

items.name: Metal Axe
items.description: An axe for cutting wood. Made from metal, it chops through Hardwood with ease, making it useful for harvesting sturdy trees that grow deep within the continent.Logging Yield Up Lv. 1

items.name: Refined Metal Axe
items.description: An axe for cutting wood. Made from high quality metal, its sharpness and durability has improved even further. It can harvest Hardwood from sturdy trees that grow in unforgiving lands.Logging Yield Up Lv. 2

items.name: Metal Detector
items.description: Using this reveals hidden Chromite deposits in dungeons, marking them for easier mining. Deposits will become unmarked if you move too far away.

items.name: Wooden Club
items.description: A Wooden Club for close range combat. Can beat a small Pal to a pulp if need be.

items.name: Bat
items.description: Baseball bat for close-range combat. Might be tough to get a home run with a Pal.

items.name: Meat Cleaver
items.description: Knife for butchering Pals. When equipped, the Pet command becomes Butcher. Butchered Pals will be gone for good.

items.name: Stun Baton
items.description: Close range weapon that sends out an electric jolt upon contact. Pals are easier to capture when electrocuted.

items.name: Crossbow
items.description: Fires an Arrow effortlessly. Though it takes time to load, it delivers a powerful shot.

items.name: Double-Barreled Shotgun
items.description: Wreaks havoc at close range. Can fire twice before reloading. Despite the limited load capacity, it still packs a punch.

items.name: Handgun
items.description: A handgun with improved capacity and rapid-fire capabilities. Has more immediate firepower than a Makeshift Handgun.

items.name: Decal Gun 1
items.description: Strange gun that paints a picture of Cattiva where it is fired. Have some fun and paint the walls or ceilings!

items.name: Decal Gun 2
items.description: Strange gun that paints a picture of Lamball where it is fired. Have some fun and paint the walls or ceilings!

items.name: Decal Gun 3
items.description: Strange gun that paints a picture of Melpaca where it is fired. Have some fun and paint the walls or ceilings!

items.name: Decal Gun 4
items.description: Strange gun that paints a picture of Anubis where it is fired. Have some fun and paint the walls or ceilings!

items.name: Decal Gun 5
items.description: Strange gun that paints a picture of Relaxaurus where it is fired. Have some fun and paint the walls or ceilings!

items.name: Homing Sphere Launcher
items.description: A launcher for firing spheres. Fired spheres home in on Pals.

items.name: Laser Rifle
items.description: A weapon that fires high-energy lasers. It has impressive firepower and is easy to handle.

items.name: Rocket Launcher
items.description: A Rocket Launcher that can fire a powerful round from long distances.

items.name: Stone Pickaxe
items.description: A pickaxe used for mining. Made from stone, the efficiency is questionable.

items.name: Metal Pickaxe

items.name: Refined Metal Pickaxe
items.description: A pickaxe used for mining. Its durability and efficiency have further improved.Mining Yield Up Lv. 2

items.name: Pump-Action Shotgun
items.description: A high capacity, powerful shotgun. It has outstanding close range DPS.

items.name: Single-Shot Rifle
items.description: A single-shot rifle. Takes time to load. What it lacks in capacity, it makes up for with sheer power.

items.name: Scatter Sphere Launcher
items.description: A new type of launcher that fires a large number of spheres. It can easily capture a herd of Pals.

items.name: Single-Shot Sphere Launcher
items.description: A launcher that fires spheres. It can capture Pals from a greater distance.

items.name: Sword
items.description: Sword for close-range combat. The blade is extremely sharp! Mightier than a pen, for sure. Requires Weapon Workbench to craft.

items.name: Frag Grenade
items.description: A Frag Grenade useful for mid-range combat. It detonates a few seconds after being thrown, dealing damage to enemies.

items.name: Incendiary Grenade
items.description: A Incendiary Grenade useful for mid-range combat. It detonates a few seconds after being thrown, setting the surrounding area on fire.

items.name: Shock Grenade
items.description: A Shock Grenade useful for mid-range combat. It detonates a few seconds after being thrown, electrocuting everything in the blast radius.

items.name: Ice Grenade
items.description: A Ice Grenade useful for mid-range combat. It detonates a few seconds after being thrown, freezing the surrounding area.

items.name: Old Bow
items.description: Primitive long range weapon. Hastily put together, it isn't very powerful.

items.name: Poison Bow
items.description: Frightening bow that poisons its target. Poisoned Pals are easier to capture. Requires Poison Arrow.

items.name: Poison Arrow Crossbow
items.description: A Crossbow that inflicts poison on its target. Poisoned Pals are easier to capture. Requires Poison Arrow.

items.name: Fire Arrow Crossbow
items.description: A Crossbow that deals Fire damage. Burns Pals with fire arrows, making them easier to capture. Requires Fire Arrow.

items.name: Three Shot Bow
items.description: An enhanced bow that allows three arrows to be fired simultaneously. By some strange mechanism, it only consumes a single Arrow when fired.

items.name: Hand-Held Torch
items.description: Lights up dark areas and keeps you warm. Can also be used for close range combat in a pinch.

items.name: Makeshift Handgun
items.description: A handgun created from spare parts. Relatively well suited for close-quarters combat, but fires only one shot at a time.

items.name: Stone Spear
items.description: Useful for close-range combat. Its length allows you to stand further away when attacking.

items.name: Metal Spear
items.description: Useful for close-range combat. The metal tip give it an increased attack power. Its length allows you to stand further away when attacking.

items.name: Refined Metal Spear
items.description: Useful for close-range combat. The high-quality metal tip give it an increased attack power. Its length allows you to stand further away when attacking.

items.name: Elizabee's Staff
items.description: A spear made from Elizabee's staff, altered for human use. It is imbued with Elizabee's indomitable spirit.

items.name: Beegarde's Spear
items.description: A spear made from the Beegarde's spear, altered for human use. Can feel a sincere loyalty.

items.name: Lily's Spear
items.description: The spear cherished by Lily. Punishes those who neglect their Pals.

items.name: Grappling Gun
items.description: It fires a hook that latches on to distant targets, pulling the user's body towards the target. It allows for easy movement between places with varying elevation.

items.name: Mega Grappling Gun
items.description: It fires a hook that latches on to distant targets, pulling the user's body towards the target. Since it's upgraded, it now has greater range.

items.name: Giga Grappling Gun
items.description: It fires a hook that latches on to distant targets, pulling the user's body towards the target. Using data from prototype versions, its capabilities have been further increased.

items.name: Hyper Grappling Gun
items.description: It fires a hook that latches on to distant targets, pulling the user's body towards the target. As a result of research, it has achieved overwhelming mobility.

items.name: Musket
items.description: Simple, old fashioned gun. Fires a single, powerful shot at the expense of a long reload time.

items.name: Gatling Gun
items.description: A Gatling Gun capable of rapid fire. Mows down enemies with suppressive fire.

items.name: Flamethrower
items.description: Flamethrower that fires long-range flame. Can set the enemy on fire.

items.name: Grenade Launcher
items.description: Fires grenades that cause wide-ranging explosions. Useful when dealing with a large number of enemies.

items.name: Guided Missile Launcher
items.description: Fires missiles that automatically track and pursue enemies. Missiles explode upon impact, causing damage over a wide area.

items.name: Multi Guided Missile Launcher
items.description: A missile launcher that can hold multiple ammo at once. Fires a series of missiles that automatically track and follow enemies.

items.name: Laser Gatling Gun
items.description: Fires beam-like energy blasts at high speed. Its overwhelming firepower can take down multiple enemies at once.

items.name: Frag Grenade Mk2
items.description: An improved frag grenade. It explodes a few seconds after being thrown, dealing massive damage to enemies.

items.name: Meteor Launcher
items.description: A phenomenal weapon that fires a meteor. Upon striking its target, it creates an explosion similar to a meteorite impact.

items.name: Dark Grenade
items.description: A Dark Grenade useful for mid-range combat. It detonates a few seconds after being thrown, dealing Dark damage to enemies.

items.name: Dragon Grenade
items.description: A Dragon Grenade useful for mid-range combat. It detonates a few seconds after being thrown, dealing Dragon damage to enemies.

items.name: Ground Grenade
items.description: A Ground Grenade useful for mid-range combat. It detonates a few seconds after being thrown, dealing Ground damage to enemies.

items.name: Grass Grenade
items.description: A Grass Grenade useful for mid-range combat. It detonates a few seconds after being thrown, dealing Grass damage to enemies.

items.name: Water Grenade
items.description: A Water Grenade useful for mid-range combat. It detonates a few seconds after being thrown, dealing Water damage to enemies.

items.name: Katana
items.description: Katana for close-range combat. Slices through with razor-sharp precision, cutting cleanly in one strike.

items.name: Beam Sword
items.description: Beam Sword for close-range combat. Slices through opponents, burning them with a high-output laser.

items.name: Semi-Auto Shotgun
items.description: A rapid-fire shotgun with immense power. Its close-range damage output is top-notch.

items.name: Plasma Cannon
items.description: Fires high-output energy projectiles. Causes an energy explosion upon impact.

items.name: Old Revolver
items.description: A slightly outdated revolving handgun. Compared to Handgun, it excels in single-shot power.

items.name: Pal Metal Pickaxe
items.description: A pickaxe for mining. It has achieved extraordinary efficiency thanks to Pal Metal.Mining Yield Up Lv. 4

items.name: Pal Metal Axe
items.description: An axe for chopping wood. It has achieved extraordinary sharpness thanks to Pal Metal. It can slice through high-grade trees from the harshest regions without trouble.Logging Yield Up Lv. 4

items.name: Makeshift Assault Rifle
items.description: An assault rifle handmade from scraps. It excels in rate of fire and long range, but its single-shot power is low.

items.name: Semi-Auto Rifle
items.description: A rifle that allows for a certain degree of rapid fire. It’s easy to aim and has high firepower, making it effective for mid-range combat.

items.name: Makeshift SMG
items.description: A submachine gun handmade from scraps. It excels in rate of fire, but its single-shot power is low.

items.name: SMG
items.description: A submachine gun with exceptional rate of fire. It’s easy to handle and effective in close-range combat.

items.name: Makeshift Shotgun
items.description: A shotgun handmade from scraps. It has a short range but excels in close-range combat

items.name: Compound Bow
items.description: A modernized bow. Capable of firing more powerful arrows.

items.name: Advanced Bow
items.description: A bow reconstructed with advanced technology. Capable of firing extremely powerful arrows.

items.name: Meowmere
items.description: [Tides of Terraria] According to the legend, this sword was brought back from a distant land by Croajiro. Why? We have no idea... Fires a bouncing cat projectile with each swing to attack enemies.

items.name: Charge Rifle
items.description: A beam rifle crafted with advanced technology. Charges energy to deliver one powerful shot.

items.name: Overheat Rifle
items.description: An assault rifle capable of firing endlessly without reloading. Prolonged bursts cause overheating, leaving you exposed. Use with caution.

items.name: Energy Shotgun
items.description: A shotgun that fires energy rounds. Excelling in rapid fire, its close-range firepower is truly otherworldly.

items.name: Boost Gun
items.description: Firing this at a Pal in your team temporarily boosts that Pal's attack and defense. Firing it at an enemy deals damage instead.

items.name: Megaboost Gun
items.description: Firing it at an allied Pal boosts their attack and defense, while hitting an enemy deals damage. Thanks to improvements, the boost is stronger and lasts longer, and it deals more damage to enemies.

items.name: Pal Recovery Grenade
items.description: A Frag Grenade with healing effects. It bursts on impact, restoring HP to allied Pals.

items.name: Terra Blade
items.description: [Tides of Terraria] This curious sword releases vibrant green shockwaves with each strike, allowing you to hit enemies from afar despite being a melee weapon.

items.name: Terraprisma
items.description: [Tides of Terraria] A mystical sword with a rainbow-colored blade. Wielding it lets you summon up to nine blessed swords to fight alongside you.

items.name: Vortex Beater
items.description: [Tides of Terraria] A powerful gun fueled by unknown energy. Fires homing missiles at regular intervals that track enemies and explode on impact. Has a 66% chance to not consume ammo when firing.

items.name: Nightglow
items.description: [Tides of Terraria] A lantern that radiates a rainbow-hued light. Holding it aloft releases homing light projectiles that strike enemies multiple times.

items.name: Excalibur
items.description: [Tides of Terraria] A sacred sword that gleams with golden light. Swinging it unleashes shockwaves around you.

items.name: Legendary Meowmere
items.description: [Tides of Terraria] A legendary Meowmere forged from Luminite Bar. Swinging it launches cat projectiles that ricochet and attack foes.

items.name: Beginner Fishing Rod (Chillet)
items.description: A fishing rod designed for catching Pals. Use it with bait near water where shadows are visible to start fishing. Perfect for beginners and ideal for reeling in low level Pals.

items.name: Beginner Fishing Rod (Gumoss)
items.description: A fishing rod designed for catching Pals. It's sturdier and offers slightly better performance than Beginner Fishing Rod (Chillet). Perfect for beginners and ideal for reeling in low level Pals.

items.name: Intermediate Fishing Rod (Cattiva)
items.description: A fishing rod designed for catching Pals. Use it with bait near water where shadows are visible to start fishing. It boasts improved performance, making catches a bit easier.

items.name: Intermediate Fishing Rod (Croajiro)
items.description: A fishing rod designed for catching Pals. It's sturdier and offers slightly better performance than Intermediate Fishing Rod (Cattiva).

items.name: Advanced Fishing Rod (Pengullet)
items.description: A fishing rod designed for catching Pals. Use it with bait near water where shadows are visible to start fishing. It boasts improved performance, making catches vastly easier.

items.name: Advanced Fishing Rod (Depresso)
items.description: A fishing rod designed for catching Pals. It's sturdier and offers slightly better performance than Advanced Fishing Rod (Pengullet).

items.name: Ultra Grappling Gun
items.description: It fires a hook that latches on to distant targets, pulling the user's body towards the target. With new materials, cooldown time has been significantly reduced.

items.name: Marksman Revolver
items.description: [ULTRAKILL Collab] An electrically powered revolver capable of firing endlessly. When equipped, Pal Sphere throws are replaced with Coin Toss. Hitting a coin with the Marksman Revolver causes the bullet to ricochet toward enemies.

items.name: Core Eject Shotgun
items.description: [ULTRAKILL Collab] A shotgun powered by heat, capable of firing endlessly. When equipped, throwing a Pal Sphere is replaced with Core Eject. Hold to charge and extend its range. Cores hit by shots from Marksman Revolver will explode.

items.name: Plasma Multicutter
items.description: A portable plasma cutter that concentrates and emits plasma energy. It supports a wide range of uses, from ore excavation to tree cutting. Its high-output energy also allows for the mining of special ores.Logging/Mining Yield Up

items.name: Combat SMG

items.description: A rifle that releases an electrical discharge from the point of impact, which chains to multiple enemies.

items.name: Beam Launcher
items.description: Fires a high-density beam that causes explosions over a wide area. Caution is required to prevent overheating during rapid fire.

items.description: Slab depicting Xenolord. Offer to a Summoning Altar to summon an inconceivably powerful Lv ?? Xenolord.

items.name: Advanced Recovery Meds
items.description: Medicine that heals wounds over time. Extremely high quality, it rapidly restores HP before your eyes.

items.name: Celestial Sigil
items.description: [Tides of Terraria] A seal inscribed with cryptic symbols. Offer to a Summoning Altar to summon a powerful entity.

items.name: Powerful Fishing Magnet
items.description: A high-powered magnet used in advanced salvage operations. Its strong magnetic pull can retrieve resources and supplies from the ocean floor.

items.name: Simple Bait
items.description: Basic fishing bait used to lure in Pals. Required for fishing.

items.name: High Quality Bait
items.description: Bait that lures in Pals. Improved so that Pals bite the bait more easily, and the amount of items obtained from fishing now increases ever so slightly.

items.name: Deluxe Bait
items.description: Bait that lures in Pals. Improved so that the bar in the minigame is slightly larger, and the amount of items obtained from fishing now increases slightly.

items.name: Alluring Bait
items.description: Bait that lures in Pals. Improved to enlarge the size of the bar in the fishing minigame and increase the number of items obtained from fishing.

items.name: Nutrient Tonic
items.description: A nutrient-rich Nutrient Tonic that prevents hunger for a period of time. A concentrated, flavorful blend of nutrients ideal for long journeys.

items.name: Hartalis Slab
items.description: Slab depicting Hartalis. Offer to a Summoning Altar to summon an exceptionally powerful Lv 70 Hartalis.

items.name: Hartalis (Ultra) Slab
items.description: Slab overflowing with Hartalis energy. Offer to a Summoning Altar to summon an inconceivably powerful Lv ?? Hartalis.

items.name: Zoe's Halloween Costume
items.description: A Halloween outfit for Zoe. She's bound to love it, so let's give it to her!

items.name: Water Awakening Crystal
items.description: A crystal formed from condensed World Tree energy. It awakens Water Pals, releasing their hidden power.

items.name: Electric Awakening Crystal
items.description: A crystal formed from condensed World Tree energy. It awakens Electric Pals, releasing their hidden power.

items.name: Ground Awakening Crystal
items.description: A crystal formed from condensed World Tree energy. It awakens Ground Pals, releasing their hidden power.

items.name: Grass Awakening Crystal
items.description: A crystal formed from condensed World Tree energy. It awakens Grass Pals, releasing their hidden power.

items.name: Fire Awakening Crystal
items.description: A crystal formed from condensed World Tree energy. It awakens Fire Pals, releasing their hidden power.

items.name: Ice Awakening Crystal
items.description: A crystal formed from condensed World Tree energy. It awakens Ice Pals, releasing their hidden power.

items.name: Dragon Awakening Crystal
items.description: A crystal formed from condensed World Tree energy. It awakens Dragon Pals, releasing their hidden power.

items.name: Dark Awakening Crystal
items.description: A crystal formed from condensed World Tree energy. It awakens Dark Pals, releasing their hidden power.

items.name: Neutral Awakening Crystal
items.description: A crystal formed from condensed World Tree energy. It awakens Neutral Pals, releasing their hidden power.

items.name: Wing Cell
items.description: The fuel required to power the Wing Pack.

items.name: Beginner Bait
items.description: Bait that lures in Pals. Improved from Simple Bait to reduce the rate at which the capture gauge drains in the fishing minigame.

items.name: Sweet Bait
items.description: Bait that lures in Pals. Improved from Simple Bait to increase the chances of Pals biting the bait.

items.name: Lucky Bait
items.description: Bait that lures in Pals. Improved from High Quality Bait to increase the number of items obtained from fishing.

items.name: Quick Bait
items.description: Bait that lures in Pals. Improved from High Quality Bait to increase the chances of Pals biting the bait.

items.name: Risky Bait
items.description: Bait that lures in Pals. A modified version of Deluxe Bait designed for skilled anglers. The minigame bar is reduced in size, but the number of items obtained is greatly increased.

items.name: Baked Berries
items.description: Cooking enhances their nutritional value, and surprisingly, they are quite filling.

items.name: Bread
items.description: Bread made from baked Flour. A tasty staple food.

items.name: Flour
items.description: Flour made from grinding Wheat. It can be used as an ingredient in making Bread.

items.name: Hot Milk
items.description: Even more delicious when warmed up. Great for keeping hunger away.

items.name: Jam-Filled Bun
items.description: Bread with jam spread on it. The sweetness of the berries complements it perfectly.

items.name: Salad
items.description: A Salad made by mixing Lettuce and Tomato. Eating it slightly improves work speed for a period of time.

items.name: Omelet
items.description: A dish made by frying an Egg and topping it with ketchup. Eating it improves Attack by +10% for a period of time.

items.name: Pancake
items.description: A dish made by mixing Flour and Milk together then baking. Eating it progressively decreases the rate at which one's sanity decreases for a period of time.

items.name: Marinated Mushrooms
items.description: A dish made by marinating Mushrooms in a marinade. Eating it improves Defense by +10% for a period of time.

items.name: Mushroom Soup
items.description: Cream soup made of Mushrooms. Eating it allows you to stay fuller for slightly longer for a period of time.

items.name: Carbonara
items.description: A dish mixing pasta with Egg and Milk. Eating it will increase Defense by +20% for a period of time.

items.name: Pizza
items.description: A dish made by piling Red Berries, Tomato and cheese on Bread. Eating it slightly improves work speed and allows you to stay fuller for slightly longer for a period of time.

items.name: Cake
items.description: A dish eaten during celebrations. Put it in the chest at a Breeding Farm to make Pals lay a particularly healthy egg.

items.name: Fried Egg
items.description: An Egg now fried and even more delicious. Great for keeping hunger away.

items.name: Baked Mushroom
items.description: Cooking this mushroom enhances its nutritional value. Curiously, it's also quite filling.

items.name: Grilled Chikipi
items.description: Chicken skewer slow-grilled over a charcoal fire. Light and refreshing on the tongue.

items.name: Lamball Kebab
items.description: Spiced and roasted mutton. Deeply complex with unique flavors.

items.name: Grilled Kelpsea
items.description: Fresh fish grilled over a charcoal fire. Plump and juicy.

items.name: Grilled Galeclaw
items.description: Grilled meat full of vitality for flying high in the skies.

items.name: Roast Rushoar
items.description: Boar grilled over a hearty flame. Crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside. Perfect as an extravagant main dish for a big party.

items.name: Broiled Dumud
items.description: Grilled fish slathered with a secret sauce. Soothes both mind and body. Perfect for tired Pal Tamers.

items.name: Roast Eikthyrdeer
items.description: Carefully roasted venison with delicate flavor notes, accented by the aromas of the deep forest. Elegant taste for an elegant lifestyle.

items.name: Roast Reindrix
items.description: When taken from a flame, Reindrix meat rapidly drops in temperature. This allows it to retain freshness for long periods of time, making it a perfect emergency ration.

items.name: Herb Roasted Caprity
items.description: Mild roast filled with the natural aromas of herbs and berries embedded in the meat. Gives a pleasant sense of warmth when eaten outdoors.

items.name: Mozzarina Steak
items.description: Thick, well-done steak. Strong flavors give those who eat it an energy boost.

items.name: Broncherry Rib Roast
items.description: Grilled meat brimming with the flavor of the king of the wilds. Juices from the compressed meat flow from the bone, making it surprisingly tender despite the initial toughness.

items.name: Mammorest Steak
items.description: Boasts a rich and dignified flavor. Memories of glaciers and deep forests come rushing back with every bite.

items.name: Chikipi Sauté
items.description: Plump poultry sautéed in butter. Accented with fresh lemons. Eating it will slightly increase work speed for a period of time.

items.name: Herb Roasted Lamball
items.description: Indulging in an abundance of fresh berries creates a tantalizing aroma that accentuates the unique flavor of mutton. Eating it will increase Defense by +10% for a period of time.

items.name: Grilled Lamball
items.description: Marinated mutton slow-cooked over a grill. Eating it will slightly increase work speed and make SAN decrease slightly slower for a period of time.

items.name: Stewed Galeclaw
items.description: Slow-cooked dish that exudes a burst of rich, wild flavors. Eating it will make SAN decrease slightly slower for a period of time.

items.name: Rushoar Bacon 'n' Eggs
items.description: The smoky essence of bacon intertwines flawlessly with the gentle texture of eggs, creating a sublime harmony of flavors. Eating it will increase Attack by +10% for a period of time.

items.name: Reindrix Stew
items.description: Stewed vegetables and venison that was reared in a frigid environment. The meat's soft texture melts away to reveal a delicate sweetness. Eating it will stay full slightly longer for a period of time.

items.name: Fried Chikipi
items.description: Magnificently juicy poultry. Eating it will slightly increase work speed and make SAN decrease slower for a period of time.

items.name: Rushoar Hot Dog
items.description: Thick sausage wedged between warm buns. The crisply seared meat and spicy flavors are to die for. Eating it will increase Defense by +20% for a period of time.

items.name: Eikthyrdeer Loco Moco
items.description: Thick hamburger steak accented with a creamy fried egg. This sublime combination brings pure joy to the mouths of those who eat it. Eating it will increase Attack by +20% for a period of time.

items.name: Eikthyrdeer Stew
items.description: A tender, melt-in-your-mouth venison stew crafted with love. The intertwining flavors of vegetables and meat create a harmonious blend that brings out a comforting richness. Eating it will increase Defense by +20% for a period of time.

items.name: Mozzarina Hamburger
items.description: The rich flavor of beef melds with the sweetness of the buns in perfect harmony in this masterpiece. Eating it will increase work speed and make SAN decrease slightly slower for a period of time.

items.name: Mozzarina Cheeseburger
items.description: Now with cheese, this dish has reached the highest level of fine cuisine. Eating it will increase Attack by +20% and stay full longer for a period of time.

items.name: Fried Kelpsea
items.description: Crunchy fried batter perfectly accentuates the Kelpsea's plumpness. Eating it will increase Defense by +10% and make SAN decrease slower for a period of time.

items.name: Dumud Chowder
items.description: Dumud lavishly covered in a thick, creamy soup. Eating it will increase work speed and stay full slightly longer for a period of time.

items.name: Rushoar Gyoza
items.description: A dish made by wrapping a filling of mushrooms and meat in wheat flour and boiling it. The chewy texture is irresistible. Eating it improves your Attack by 10% for a period of time.

items.name: Stir-Fried Vegetables
items.description: A dish made by stir-frying Carrot and Onion. A simple and delicious way to enjoy vegetables. Eating it will slightly increase your work speed and improve your Defense by 10% for a period of time.

items.name: French Fries
items.description: A dish made by deep-frying Potato. Once you start eating, you can't stop. Eating it will make it harder for your SAN value to decrease for a period of time.

items.name: Broncherry Fried Noodles
items.description: A dish made by stir-frying noodles with vegetables and meat. The rich seasoning pairs perfectly with the thick cuts of meat. Eating it will increase your Attack by 20% for a period of time.

items.name: Spring Rolls
items.description: A dish made by wrapping vegetables and mushrooms in a thin skin and deep-frying them. The crispy texture is delightful. Eating it will make it harder for your SAN value to decrease and increase your Attack by 10% for a period of time.

items.name: Gratin
items.description: A dish made by coating potatoes with sauce and baking them to perfection. Best enjoyed hot and fresh. Eating it will provide lasting fullness and increase your Defense by 10% for a period of time.

items.name: Minestrone
items.description: A soup simmered with a variety of vegetables. Drinking it warms you to the core. Eating it will increase your work speed for a period of time.

items.name: Mammorest Curry
items.description: A dish made by simmering vegetables and meat with spices. The rich flavor is highlighted by large chunks of tender meat. Eating it will increase your Attack by 25% for a period of time.

items.name: Galeclaw Nikujaga
items.description: A dish made by simmering meat and potatoes in a sweet and savory sauce. It has a mysteriously nostalgic taste. Eating it will increase your Defense by 25% for a period of time.

items.name: Mushroom Quiche
items.description: A dish made by baking a pastry crust filled with eggs, vegetables, mushrooms, and cream. It’s delicious even when cooled. Eating it will help you stay fuller for a while and make it harder for your SAN value to decrease for a period of time.

items.name: Fried Gloopie Balls
items.description: Gloopie Tentacle encased in a Flour dough and grilled into round bites. Eating it will slightly increase EXP gain for a period of time.

items.name: Jelliette's Jiggly Jelly
items.description: An unusual treat crafted from Jelliette Bell Flesh and Aquatic Pal Fluids. Eating it will slightly increase EXP gain and increase Attack by +10% for a period of time.

items.name: Jellroy's Jolly Jelly
items.description: An unusual treat crafted from Jellroy Bell Flesh and Red Berries. Eating it will slightly increase EXP gain and increase Defense by +10% for a period of time.

items.name: Munchill Steak
items.description: Charcoal-grilled to perfection, this steak offers a crispy exterior and melt-in-your-mouth juiciness. Unique compounds seal in flavor and enhance shelf life.

items.name: Seafood Salad
items.description: A healthy salad made with Gloopie Tentacle and Lettuce. Eating it will slightly increase EXP gain for a period of time.

items.name: Salt-Grilled Skutlass
items.description: Fresh fillets of Skutlass salted and grilled into a simple dish. When eaten, it nullifies knockback and flinching for a certain period of time.

items.name: Seafood Pasta
items.description: Fresh pasta is tossed with fragrant seafood in this exceptional dish, using Gloopie tentacles to elevate it even further. When eaten, it nullifies damage from explosions for a certain period of time.

items.name: Mushroom Cake
items.description: Place it in the chest at a Breeding Farm to make Pals lay a particularly healthy egg. The talents of the resulting Pals will grow slightly more easily.

items.name: Vegetable Cake
items.description: Place it in the chest at a Breeding Farm to make Pals lay a particularly healthy egg. Lay eggs twice at once.

items.name: Extravagant Vegetable Cake
items.description: Place it in the chest at a Breeding Farm to make Pals lay a particularly healthy egg. Mutations are more likely to occur, and talents will grow more easily.

items.name: Special Cake
items.description: Place it in the chest at a Breeding Farm to make Pals lay a particularly healthy egg. More likely inherit multiple passive skills from their parents.

items.name: Gold Coin
items.description: Currency traded on Palpagos Island. Can be exchanged for items or Pals with merchants.

items.name: Charcoal
items.description: Charcoal made from burning Wood. It can be combined with Sulfur to create Gunpowder.

items.name: Cloth
items.description: Cloth woven from Wool. Required to create armor. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

items.name: High Quality Cloth
items.description: High Quality Cloth woven from a large amount of Wool. Required to create high quality armor. Can be crafted at High Quality Workbench.

items.name: Ingot
items.description: A material required to create metal weapons and armor. Refined from Ore using a furnace.

items.name: Fiber
items.description: Fiber collected from trees. A material used when creating bows, etc. Can also be obtained by breaking down Wood at a Crusher.

items.name: Gunpowder
items.description: Gunpowder used to fire ammunition. Required to make bullets.

items.name: Refined Ingot
items.description: A material required to create high quality metal weapons and armor. Refined from Ore and Coal using a furnace.

items.name: Wooden Board
items.description: Planks made from processed wood for easier use. More versatile than raw logs, with a wide variety of uses. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

items.name: High Quality Wooden Board
items.description: Fine planks carefully carved from Hardwood. They have beautiful wood grain and are used for structures with a luxurious feel. Can be crafted at Production Assembly Line II.

items.name: Nail
items.description: Necessary for building various facilities. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

items.name: Circuit Board
items.description: Required to create precision equipment. Can be crafted at Production Assembly Line.

items.name: Pal Metal Ingot
items.description: A material required to create Pal Metal weapons and armor. Strengthened by creating an alloy incorporating Paldium.

items.name: Plasteel
items.description: Material created by processing Crude Oil and metal. Can be produced in an Electric Furnace.

items.name: Computer
items.description: A component used in the control of automated equipment and precision machinery. It's a key component forming the foundation of modern technology. Can be crafted at Production Assembly Line II.

items.name: AI Core
items.description: A core component essential to cutting-edge devices, enabling complex decision-making and autonomous control. Can be crafted at Advanced Workshop.

items.name: Cryogenic Coolant
items.description: A high-efficiency cooling medium made from special components derived from Pals. Used to regulate temperature in high-output devices. Can be crafted at Production Assembly Line.

items.name: Bio Battery
items.description: A device that stores bio-energy as electrical power. Used for equipment requiring high energy density. Can be crafted at Production Assembly Line II.

items.name: Thermal Core
items.description: A high-temperature reaction core containing vast thermal energy. Used as a power component in advanced devices. Can be crafted at Production Assembly Line II.

items.name: Corrosive Solvent
items.description: A dangerous chemical solvent with strong decomposing properties. Used for precision processing and special treatments. Can be crafted at Production Assembly Line.

items.name: Small Pal Soul
items.description: A spirit left behind by a small Pal. It can draw out hidden abilities if offered to a Statue of Power.

items.name: Medium Pal Soul
items.description: A spirit left behind by a Pal. It can draw out hidden abilities if offered to a Statue of Power.

items.name: Large Pal Soul
items.description: A spirit left behind by a large Pal. It can draw out hidden abilities if offered to a Statue of Power.

items.name: Polymer
items.description: Polymer made from refined oil. Required for producing various advanced items such as firearms. Can be crafted at Production Assembly Line.

items.name: Cement
items.description: Cement used for creating structures and more. Can be produced in a High Quality Workbench.

items.name: Carbon Fiber
items.description: A lightweight yet sturdy material. Used to create armor and other equipment. Can be crafted at Production Assembly Line.

items.name: Giant Pal Soul
items.description: The soul left behind by a highly trained Pal. It can draw out hidden abilities if offered to a Statue of Power.

items.name: Hexolite
items.description: An alloy of Chromite and Hexolite Quartz. Used for building advanced equipment and structures. Can be refined at Gigantic Furnace.

items.name: Coralum Ingot
items.description: An alloy made from Coralum Ore found on the ocean floor. Highly resistant to energy, making it ideal for crafting weapons. Can be refined at Gigantic Furnace.

items.name: Paldium Fragment
items.description: Crystallized energy from the World Tree. Capable of creating supernatural items and structures.

items.name: Soralite Ingot
items.description: An ancient metal refined from ore that slumbers in Sunreach. A rare processed material, forming the foundation of high-grade equipment and structures. Can be refined at Ancient Furnace.

items.name: Paloxite Ingot
items.description: An indomitable alloy created by fusing Soralite and Paloxite. A highly rare material, crystallizing the technology of ancient civilization and the power of the World Tree. It is vital for crafting the highest-grade equipment and structures.

items.name: Mythical Wooden Board
items.description: Planks made by processing mystical wood, emitting a faint light. They contain power beyond human understanding and make an ideal core material.

items.name: Primitive Workbench
items.description: A Primitive Workbench for producing simple items. Requires a Pal that can work with their hands.

items.name: Repair Bench
items.description: Workbench for repairing broken tools. Materials are needed to make repairs.

items.name: Pal Gear Workbench
items.description: A Primitive Workbench for producing Pal tools. Make a saddle to ride Pals, or make a gun for Pals to use.

items.name: Stone Pit
items.description: A facility for producing Stone. Mining Stone is hard work that requires much physical endurance. Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.

items.name: Logging Site
items.description: A facility for producing Wood. Cutting wood is hard work that requires much physical endurance. Leave it to Pals skilled in logging.

items.name: Crusher
items.description: Facility for breaking down Stone and Wood to exchange them for other materials. Requires Pal with the Watering trait to spin the water turbine.

items.name: Primitive Furnace
items.description: Allows refinement of Ingot. The quality leaves much to desire, and processing is slow. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

items.name: High Quality Workbench
items.description: An Assembly Line for producing items and gear. A small workspace limits production speeds. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

items.name: Medieval Medicine Workbench
items.description: A facility for making Pal medicine. It can only produce simple medicines. Leave its operation to a Pal that can make medicine.

items.name: Sphere Workbench
items.description: A Primitive Workbench for producing spheres used for capturing Pals. A small workspace keeps the production speed slow. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

items.name: Mill
items.description: Facility for milling Wheat to produce Flour. Requires Pal with the Watering trait to spin the water turbine.

items.name: Weapon Workbench
items.description: A Primitive Workbench for producing weapons and ammunition. A small workspace prevents the production of high quality weapons. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

items.name: Ore Mining Site
items.description: Facility for producing Ore. Mining Ore is hard work that requires physical endurance. Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.

items.name: Sphere Assembly Line
items.description: An Assembly Line for producing spheres used for capturing Pals. By splitting Pals into groups, production speeds have somewhat increased. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

items.name: Production Assembly Line
items.description: An Assembly Line for producing items and gear. By splitting Pals into groups, production speeds have somewhat increased. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

items.name: Fishing Pond
items.description: A ready-to-use fishing pond. Assign a Pal to fish here at their own leisure. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

items.name: Weapon Assembly Line
items.description: An Assembly Line for producing weapons and ammunition. By splitting Pals into groups, production speeds have somewhat increased. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

items.name: Improved Furnace
items.description: Allows refinement of Refined Ingot. The quality has improved, but the processing speed is still unsatisfactory. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

items.name: Sphere Assembly Line II
items.description: An Assembly Line for producing spheres used for capturing Pals. Through clever management, production speeds have greatly increased. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

items.name: Coal Mine
items.description: Facility for producing Coal. Digging Coal is grueling physical work. Leave it to a Pal that is good at mining.

items.name: Ore Mining Site II
items.description: Facility for producing large quantities of Ore. Mining Ore is hard work that requires physical endurance. Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.

items.name: Production Assembly Line II
items.description: An Assembly Line for producing items and gear. Through clever management, production speeds have greatly increased. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

items.name: Electric Medicine Workbench
items.description: A facility for making Pal medicine. It requires electricity, but can produce high quality medicine. Leave its operation to a Pal that can make medicine.

items.name: Logging Site II
items.description: Facility for producing Hardwood. Cutting wood is hard work that requires much physical endurance. Leave it to Pals skilled in logging.

items.name: Electric Furnace
items.description: Allows refinement of Pal Metal Ingot. It requires electricity to use, but is quicker to process. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

items.name: Drafting Table
items.description: A facility that lets you combine multiple schematics to create more advanced ones.

items.name: Sulfur Mine
items.description: Facility for producing Sulfur. Digging Sulfur is grueling physical work. Leave it to a Pal that is good at mining.

items.name: Weapon Assembly Line II
items.description: An Assembly Line for producing weapons and ammunition. Through clever management, production speeds have greatly increased. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

items.name: Crude Oil Extractor
items.description: Equipment required to extract Crude Oil from oil fields. Requires a power supply to operate.

items.name: High-Pressure Crude Oil Extractor
items.description: A device that pumps and extracts Crude Oil from deep underground. It can produce Crude Oil even in areas without oil fields, but it can only be placed on open ground with no structures beneath it. It requires a far greater supply of electricity than the Crude Oil Extractor.

items.name: Pure Quartz Quarry
items.description: A facility for producing Pure Quartz. Mining Pure Quartz is grueling physical work. Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.

items.name: Refrigerated Crusher
items.description: Facility that crushes Ore and converts it into other materials. Requires a power supply and a Pal with Cooling suitability, but it's very efficient.

items.name: Advanced Sphere Assembly Line
items.description: An Assembly Line for producing spheres used for capturing Pals. Advanced machinery has been introduced, allowing for the production of spheres at high speed. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

items.name: Gigantic Furnace
items.description: Allows refinement of Hexolite. By growing in size, multiple Pals can collaborate to perform smelting. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

items.name: Advanced Medicine Workbench
items.description: A facility for making medicine to cure Pals' illnesses. With advanced technology, it can also create unknown medicines. Assign the task to a Pal capable of pharmacy work.

items.name: Advanced Workshop
items.description: An Assembly Line for producing items and gear. Advanced machinery has been introduced, enabling high-speed production. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

items.name: Hexolite Quartz Mine
items.description: Facility for producing Hexolite Quartzs. Digging Hexolite Quartzs is grueling physical work. Leave it to a Pal that is good at mining.

items.name: Advanced Weapon Assembly Line
items.description: An Assembly Line for producing weapons and ammunition. Advanced machinery has been introduced, enabling high-speed weapon production. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

items.name: Ancient Furnace
items.description: A special furnace based on ancient technology that can smelt all types of ingots. Materials are melted with fire, then quickly cooled and solidified using ice. It requires Pals with high-level Kindling and Cooling suitability.

items.name: Ancient Workbench
items.description: A Pal-exclusive workbench that is capable of crafting any item in one place. It cannot be used by the player, and operates at the same speed as a regular workbench. Due to its advanced equipment, it requires Pals with high-level Handiwork and Medicine Production suitability.

items.name: Large Fishing Pond
items.description: A ready-to-use large fishing pond. The expanded body of water makes it possible to catch even larger Pals. Requires Pals that can work with their hands.

items.name: Soralite Quarry
items.description: Facility for producing Soralite. Digging Soralite is grueling physical work. Leave it to a Pal that is good at mining.

items.name: Gold Coin Assembly Line
items.description: An Assembly Line that manufactures Gold Coin. The work puts a strain on the mind, causing a decrease in Pal's SAN value. Requires Pals that can work with their hands. Warning: building this facility may draw severe scrutiny from the PIDF.

items.name: Ancient Relic Recycler
items.description: An ancient civilization device that converts materials using repurposed technology from a lost civilization. It deciphers the technology left within Ancient Relics and refines them into new forms. A highly specialized facility designed for the efficient use of relics without waste.

items.name: Ancient Material Synthesizer
items.description: A special generator based on ancient technology that uses the power of the World Tree to produce all kinds of wood and ore. Due to its complex structure, only one Pal can be assigned to it.

items.name: Palbox
items.description: Facility for storing captured Pals. Pals inside gradually recover Health. Area around this facility becomes a base.

items.name: Pal Dressing Facility
items.description: Pal Dressing Facility. Give your Pals a new look! Skins obtained inside and outside the game can be applied here!

items.name: Global Palbox
items.description: A facility that can store the genetic data of Pals and allows you to reconstruct them from this data. The stored genetic data can also be transferred to other worlds.

items.name: Ranch
items.description: Farm for raising sheep and fowl-like Pals. Assign a Pal with the appropriate Partner Skill to a farm to produce items.

items.name: Monitoring Stand
items.description: Command your Pals to work on various things inside a base. You can allow or prohibit individual kinds of work.

items.name: Statue of Power
items.description: Stone statue spoken of in legends on Palpagos Island. Offer up Lifmunk Effigy to receive strange powers.

items.name: Egg Incubator
items.description: Used for incubating a Pal Egg. If a Pal Egg is left in it, it will automatically hatch after some time has passed.

items.name: Pal Essence Condenser
items.description: A chamber for increasing a Pal's rank. Pals can surpass their physical limitations if given a concentrated extract taken from a Pal of the same type.

items.name: Viewing Cage
items.description: Container for observing captured Pals. Pals inside cannot participate in battle or production, but they do not become hungry.Disabled on multiplayer to prevent performance issues.

items.name: Breeding Farm
items.description: Assign one male and one female Pal to produce eggs. Placing Cake in the facility is required for production.

items.name: Pal Labor Research Lab
items.description: A facility for conducting research on the various tasks of Pals. By assigning tasks to Pals in this facility, research progresses, granting various benefits.

items.name: Dimensional Pal Storage
items.description: A facility for storing a large number of captured Pals. Any guild member can deposit or withdraw Pals. If you set it to private, it can serve as your personal Pal storage.

items.name: Pal Expedition Station
items.description: A facility that allows Pals to be sent on expeditions to places like dungeons. The dispatched Pals engage in battles and gather items, bringing back resources to the base.

items.name: High Quality Monitoring Stand
items.description: A refined monitoring station with improved materials and structure. In addition to being able to issue work orders, the system also lowers the SAN cost for Pals working at the base. Working conditions are slightly improved, making Pals less likely to become dissatisfied.

items.name: Palbox Control Device
items.description: A remote-access terminal for the Palbox. Set it up wherever you'd like and build a base of your own design.

items.name: Summoning Altar
items.description: Offer a Slab depicting a Pal to summon a powerful Pal to your base. Adequate caution and battle readiness is paramount.

items.name: Electric Egg Incubator
items.description: Device for incubating Pal eggs. Requires electricity, but automatically keeps the inside of the incubator at appropriate temperatures.

items.name: Pal Surgery Table
items.description: A facility where surgery can be performed on Pals to change their gender or passive skills.

items.name: Large Incubator
items.description: Device for incubating Pal eggs. It automatically maintains a suitable temperature and can hatch multiple eggs at once.

items.name: Pal Disassembly Conveyor
items.description: A dream-like facility that automatically butchers any Pal that is placed inside.

items.name: Large-Scale Electric Egg Incubator
items.description: Device for incubating Pal eggs. While power supply is required, it allows multiple eggs to be incubated simultaneously at the optimal temperature.

items.name: Ancient Monitoring Stand
items.description: A monitoring station based on ancient technology, embedded with Red Paldium. It issues commands across the entire base through a holographic interface, reducing SAN depletion in Pals. A special wavelength surrounds the base, keeping Pals calm even in harsh working environments.

items.name: Ancient Hatchery
items.description: An advanced breeding facility of ancient civilization technology, enclosed in electronic glass. It fully automates everything from egg production to incubation at high speed, and increases the inheritance rate of rare skills. Pals are managed through holograms, it requires minimal pasture space.

items.name: Wooden Chest
items.description: Stores items. Made from wood, it breaks easily. It's probably not the best thing to store valuables in.

items.name: Wooden Barrel
items.description: Wooden barrel for storing items.

items.description: Wooden box for storing items.

items.description: Wooden shelf for storing items.

items.name: Wooden Barrel Shelf
items.description: Wooden barrel shelf for storing items.

items.name: Wooden Wall Shelf
items.description: Wooden shelf for storing items. Can be placed on a wall.

items.description: Antique bookshelf for storing items.

items.name: Antique Wardrobe

items.name: Antique Chest
items.description: Antique chest for storing items. Adorned with a photo of a Pal.

items.name: Antique Side Chest
items.description: Antique side chest for storing items. Adorned with a photo of a Pal.

items.name: Iron Wall Shelf
items.description: Iron wall shelf for storing items. Can be placed on a wall.

items.name: Metal Chest
items.description: Stores items. Reinforced with metal, it is somewhat durable. The increased size allows for the storage of more things.

items.name: Cooler Box
items.description: Small food vault. Assign an Ice Pal to help prevent food stored inside from spoiling.

items.name: Antique Cabinet
items.description: Antique cabinet for storing items.

items.name: Antique Long Cabinet
items.description: Antique long cabinet for storing items. Adorned with a photo of a Pal.

items.description: Large antique cabinet for storing items.

items.name: Antique Wall Cabinet
items.description: Antique cabinet for storing items. Can be placed on walls.

items.name: Iron Shelf
items.description: Iron shelf for storing items.

items.name: Long Iron Shelf
items.description: Long iron shelf for storing items.

items.name: Orange Locker
items.description: Orange locker for storing items. Decorated with Pal stickers.

items.name: Locker
items.description: Locker for storing items. Decorated with Pal stickers.

items.name: Large Container
items.description: Large container for storing items. Imitates the designs left behind by an ancient and prosperous civilization.

items.name: Small Container
items.description: Small container for storing items.

items.name: Cloth Covered Container
items.description: Cloth covered container for storing items.

items.name: Refrigerator
items.description: Large food vault. Assign an Ice Pal to help prevent food stored inside from spoiling.

items.name: Refined Metal Chest
items.description: Stores items. Made of iron, it is extremely durable. It is useful as a large, secure storage box.

items.name: Guild Chest
items.description: A chest that can instantly send and receive items through subspace. The items inside are shared across all bases where it is placed.

items.name: Item Retrieval Machine
items.description: A device that lets you freely access items from all chests in the base.

items.name: Japanese-Style Chest
items.description: Stores items. Perfect for Japanese-style buildings.

items.name: Advanced Chest
items.description: Stores items. Quite sturdy, with plenty of storage space. It is useful as a large, secure storage box.

items.name: Campfire
items.description: Needed for cooking food. It can only be used to grill simple ingredients. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

items.name: Feed Box
items.description: A box for storing Pal food. Pals can feed from it when hungry. Make sure to keep it well-stocked to keep your Pals happy.

items.name: Berry Plantation
items.description: A farm that can grow Red Berries. Harvest time is quick, but eating them doesn't provide much sustenance. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

items.name: Wheat Plantation
items.description: A farm that can grow Wheat. It requires an average amount of time to harvest. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest crops.

items.name: Cooking Pot
items.description: Needed for cooking food. Use of a cooking pot allows for a wider variety of meal preparation. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

items.name: Tomato Plantation
items.description: A farm that can grow Tomato. They take time to harvest, but increase the variety of meals you can prepare. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

items.name: Lettuce Plantation
items.description: A farm that can grow Lettuce. It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

items.name: Potato Plantation
items.description: A farm where you can grow Potato. It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

items.name: Carrot Plantation
items.description: A farm where you can grow Carrot. It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

items.name: Onion Plantation
items.description: A farm where you can grow Onion. It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

items.name: Electric Kitchen
items.description: Needed for cooking food. It requires electricity to run, but allows a large amount of meals to be prepared rapidly. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

items.name: Large-Scale Stone Oven
items.description: Needed for cooking food. By becoming larger, multiple Pals can cooperate to cook together. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

items.name: Cold Food Box
items.description: A feeding box that can be kept cold. Assign an Ice Pal to it and the food inside will be less likely to spoil.

items.name: Ancient Kitchen
items.description: A special kitchen based on ancient technology that can create everything from existing dishes to entirely new recipes. It retains heat through fire and completes cooking with manual preparation, allowing it to prepare any kind of cuisine. It requires Pals with high-level Kindling and Handiwork suitability.

items.name: Skillfruit Orchard
items.description: A farm where Skillfruits can be cultivated. By planting the original fruit in the ground, multiple fruits of the same type can be harvested.

items.name: Ancient Farm
items.description: A special cultivation device based on ancient technology that harnesses the power of the World Tree to grow all kinds of plants on Palpagos Island. Smaller than a berry plantation and suitable for indoor placement, it still follows the same cultivation process as standard plots. It requires Pals with high-level Planting, Watering, and Harvesting suitability.

items.name: Shoddy Bed
items.description: A shoddy bed for humans. Use it when injured or to sleep at night. You won't be able to sleep soundly without a roof over your head.

items.name: Straw Pal Bed
items.description: A straw bed for Pals. Pals can rest on it when injured, or to sleep at night. It isn't soft, but it's better than nothing.

items.name: Hot Spring
items.description: Facility where Pals on base can rest. Restores SAN after a long day of hard work.

items.name: Heater
items.description: A device that blows warm air, raising the temperature of a base. It doesn't provide much warmth, but helps one to endure somewhat cold environments. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

items.name: Cooler
items.description: A device that blows cool air, lowering the temperature of a base. It doesn't provide much relief from the heat, but helps one to endure somewhat hot environments. Requires an Ice Pal for cooling.

items.name: Fluffy Pal Bed
items.description: A fluffy bed that Pals can get a good rest on. Pals can rest on it when injured, or to sleep at night. Pals love sleeping on fluffy beds like this.

items.name: Medicine Rack
items.description: A shelf for storing medicine. Sick Pals will come here to take their medicine. Be sure to keep the medicine stocked.

items.name: Clinic
items.description: A basic medical facility for managing the health of Pals working at the base. Assigning a Pal with Medicine Production suitability helps reduce SAN depletion and prevent illness and injury. While sanitation has its limits, it plays a crucial role in early base development.

items.name: Power Generator
items.description: A power generator fueled by Electric Pals. Electric equipment won't run without this.

items.name: Human-Powered Generator
items.description: A facility that converts rotational motion into electrical energy. The efficiency is low, and the Pals working here will experience a decrease in SAN value, but they will gain experience points.

items.name: Fine Bed
items.description: A fluffy bed for humans. Use it when injured or to sleep at night. You won't be able to sleep soundly without a roof over your head.

items.name: High Quality Hot Spring
items.description: Facility where Pals on base can rest. Now comfier and restores more SAN.

items.name: Large Pal Bed
items.description: A fluffy bed that Pals can get a good rest on. Pals can rest on it when injured, or to sleep at night. Even large Pals can sleep soundly on a bed like this.

items.name: Accumulator
items.description: A facility for storing excess electricity generated by the Power Generator.

items.name: Electric Heater
items.description: A device that blows warm air, raising the temperature of a base. Using electricity, it can really heat things up. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

items.name: Electric Cooler
items.description: A device that blows cool air, lowering the temperature of a base. Using electricity, it can really lower the temperature. Requires an Ice Pal for cooling.

items.name: Large Power Generator
items.description: A power generator fueled by Electric Pals. Larger and with improved power generation efficiency.

items.name: Pal Pod
items.description: A healing pod for Pals. Used when Pals are injured or to rest at night. Thanks to technological advancements, the healing amount has increased.

items.name: Japanese-Style Hot Spring
items.description: Facility where Pals on base can rest. Its calming, traditional Japanese design offers an extra boost to SAN recovery.

items.name: Ancient Clinic
items.description: A top-tier medical facility that reproduces advanced ancient medical technology. It offers significantly greater protective capability than a standard clinic. By assigning a Pal with Medicine Production suitability, even bases with harsh working conditions can maintain the highest level of hygiene.

items.name: Ancient Pal Bed
items.description: An ultimate Pal Bed made from ancient recovery pod with soft matress. It offers one of the highest SAN recovery rates of all Pal beds, quickly relieving fatigue. It is the same size as a Large Pal Bed, allowing large Pals to rest comfortably.

items.name: Ancient Power Generator
items.description: A highly efficient power generator restored from lost ancient technology. It produces massive amounts of electricity, but is prone to overheating while in operation. It requires Pals with high-level Generating Electricity and any level of Watering suitability.

items.name: Ancient Hot Spring
items.description: A hot spring built with ancient technology, filled with special water infused with Paldium. It offers the highest SAN recovery of all hot springs and also restores Health. It is the same size as a standard hot spring, and can fully heal injured Pals.

items.name: Great Eagle Statue
items.description: A stone monument in the shape of a Chikipi. Allows fast travel to the location where it is placed.
